findings.mechanism: Handler.Serve calls hub.Open for every request, which starts a Subscription worker goroutine (subscription.go:265, go s.run()). Serve never calls sub.Close(), including on its early-return error paths, so the goroutine blocks forever in select on events/flushes/done. Each leaked goroutine pins its Subscription: a 4096-byte scratch buffer, 4 channels, and its goroutine stack.
findings.cause: missing defer sub.Close() in Handler.Serve (one subscription per request, never closed)
findings.evidence: Scratch test (since removed) drove workload.Build() and Serve for 4 batches of 2000 requests, forcing GC after each. Goroutines: 2002, 4002, 6002, 8002. HeapInuse: 11.7MB, 22.5MB, 33.7MB, 44.6MB. That is one goroutine per request with linear growth and no plateau, and GC does not reclaim any of it. Close() is only called in tests.
findings.discriminator: Fix: add defer sub.Close() after the Open error check in Serve. Goroutine count should then stay flat.

findings.mechanism: The 4096-byte scratch buffer is allocated per subscription and is retained for the lifetime of the leaked worker goroutine. This is the memory part of the same leak, about 5KB per request counting stack and channels.
findings.cause: same root cause as handler.go:18; the buffer is reachable only because the worker goroutine is never stopped
findings.evidence: HeapInuse grew about 11MB per 2000 requests, roughly 5.5KB per request, matching the buffer plus channels and the goroutine.

findings.mechanism: MemorySink keeps only an int count, a byte count and a checksum. It does not retain messages.
findings.evidence: Code reading: Deliver updates 3 scalars under a mutex. Heap growth matches the per-subscription cost above.
findings.discriminator: Sink state is constant-size scalars, not a collection.

findings.mechanism: Renderer.layouts is a map copied once at construction and never written afterwards. Hub.opened is only an atomic counter.
findings.evidence: Code reading: no writes to layouts after NewRenderer. The topic set is fixed at 4 entries.
findings.discriminator: The map is read-only after construction and its size is constant.
